segments.text: Welcome to the Contoso partnership kickoff.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: We want a small integration pilot before discussing a wider rollout.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Our team can provide a sandbox tenant this week.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: What workflow should the pilot cover?
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: A customer uploads a document and receives a status callback.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The callback endpoint needs signed requests.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: We can use rotating HMAC secrets for the pilot.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: How long will a secret remain valid during rotation?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Both keys can overlap for twenty-four hours.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: That should avoid missed callbacks.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: We need a written retry policy too.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: We retry for six hours with exponential backoff.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Please include an idempotency key on each event.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: That is required by our operations team.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I will send the webhook schema on Thursday.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Who owns the sandbox credentials?
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: I will create them and share through our secure portal.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Please do not put credentials in the meeting notes.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Understood. What is the pilot deadline?
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: We want the end-to-end demo by November twelfth.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I can deliver the callback handler by October twenty-third.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: We will reserve the following week for testing.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Could Northwind participate in the first pilot?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Only after their procurement and security reviews finish.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Then use our internal sample account for now.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Agreed; the pilot uses synthetic documents.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: What measures define success?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Ninety-nine percent of callbacks arrive within five minutes.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: And no duplicate document processing after retries.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: I will circulate the success criteria on Friday.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I will add trace IDs to the schema.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: We will meet weekly until the demo.
segments.speaker: me
